items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Harold Arlen's lovely theme, "Over the Rainbow."

ctx.x: And then it said, your alto style is in the solo sequences of (inaudible) Ernie Wilkins's arrangements of "Basie English," "The Moon's Now High," and "Small Hotel," as well as having several lengthy ballads, most notable of which are "Falling in Love All Over Again," scored by Neal Hefti, "You're Not the Kind," scored by Ernie Wilkins and Harold Arlen's lovely theme, "Over the Rainbow." (inaudible). Those right?
